points: Nevuchadnetzar orders his general Nevuzaradan to protect Yirmiyahu, since he was the one telling people to surrender.
Per the Midrash, Yirmiyahu shackles himself and goes with the people into exile, to share their pain, until Hashem tells him to go back to Gedaliah.
Bavel appoints Gedaliah as governor, based in Mitzpah in Binyamin. Jews scattered around the region come back and start planting again. Things are looking up.
Yishmael, from the line of Dovid, is jealous and plots to kill Gedaliah. Gedaliah is warned, even offered a secret operation, and refuses to believe it.
The lesson: when our enemies say they want to kill us, like Hamas's charter, we must take them at their word. Gedaliah was too naive, and Jewish history paid the price.
